exact_meaning: Reviewed equivalence of source capability facet to target definition; not whole requirement/outcome equivalence, not keyword association.
eligibility: APPROVED and ACTIVE exact mapping + ACTIVE target definition/pack under pinned context + unchanged source version/checksum + separately approved target-compatible claim scope.
coverage: Course evidence must establish development/coverage; direct/supporting type plus behavior/context scope separately reviewed. Narrow evidence cannot silently satisfy broader requirement.
provider_topics: Context/source concept only; cannot create course development claim without outcome/claim evidence.
rules: Human-approved rule releases may propose deterministic mappings under exact conditions; instantiated evidence/review required.
source_edit: New source version invalidates live binding pending re-review; new profile projection/version required.
